Reproduce with: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest --run-nightly -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 tests/test_3c_carried_start.py tests/test_3c_item_facts_capture.py tests/test_3c_no_close_arm.py tests/test_3c_state_compare.py tests/test_3c_world_capture_wiring.py tests/test_game_path_journeys.py`.

Delete exactly these six test functions. Then remove only the imports, helpers, fixtures and constants that became unused in each file (ruff F401/F841 must pass); if a file would end up with no tests at all, delete the file instead. Do NOT touch any other test in those files, and do NOT touch scripts/.

PART 2 (pin four journeys as a named issue). In tests/test_game_path_journeys.py the four parametrized cases of test_every_player_realization_has_an_earned_continuation_to_the_ending for k_sl_3c_d_r1, k_sl_3c_d_r2, k_sl_3c_e_r1 and k_sl_3c_e_r2 fail with 'was never offered on a legal route'. This is a real story gap, not a test bug, so do NOT make the test pass by changing the policy. Pin them the way the module docstring promises for named issues: add a module constant (for example KNOWN_UNREACHABLE: dict[str, str]) mapping those four ids to one reason string that names the cause and says 'story gap N-3: the 3C aftermath storylets D and E cannot play; fix the package, then delete this entry', and build the parametrization so those four ids carry pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason=...). Strict means the day the story is fixed the test fails and forces deleting the entry. Update the module docstring line that says two branches are pinned so it describes what is true now. All other cases must still pass unchanged.

Report in NOTES.txt exactly which helpers and imports you removed.
tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-24
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -vE '^(tests/test_3c_carried_start\.py|tests/test_3c_item_facts_capture\.py|tests/test_3c_no_close_arm\.py|tests/test_3c_state_compare\.py|tests/test_3c_world_capture_wiring\.py|tests/test_game_path_journeys\.py)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 tests/test_3c_cue_chain.py tests/test_3c_finale_journey.py
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "tests took $took s (budget 300 s)"
[ "$took" -le 300 ] || { echo "over the 300 s budget"; exit 1; }
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep '\.py$' || true)
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES

out=$(.venv/bin/python -m pytest --run-nightly -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 tests/test_3c_carried_start.py tests/test_3c_item_facts_capture.py tests/test_3c_no_close_arm.py tests/test_3c_state_compare.py tests/test_3c_world_capture_wiring.py tests/test_game_path_journeys.py 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | tail -30; exit 1; }
echo "$out" | tail -3
echo "$out" | grep -Eq '4 xfailed' || { echo "expected exactly 4 xfailed journey cases"; exit 1; }
! echo "$out" | grep -Eq ' failed| xpassed' || { echo "unexpected failures or xpass"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'xfail' tests/test_game_path_journeys.py && grep -q 'strict=True' tests/test_game_path_journeys.py || { echo "journey pin missing"; exit 1; }
for t in test_carried_run_row_uses_scene_turns_from_one_without_network test_checker_accepts_carried_dry_run_and_rejects_tampered_cap test_capture_enabled_dry_run_passes_checker test_existing_arm_dry_run_remains_byte_stable test_state_compare_runs_offline_end_to_end test_item_facts_dry_run_marks_world_capture_without_creating_jev_client; do
  ! grep -rq "def $t" tests/ || { echo "stale test $t still present"; exit 1; }
done

git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/nightly-green.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/nightly-green.patch"
